channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Na TV, Lula fala em País destruído após Bolsonaro; Flávio traça perfil próprio
item.description: On the first day of free electoral time, Lula criticized the Bolsonaro government, describing the country as 'destroyed' and launched a new campaign slogan. Flávio Dino began his political trajectory with his own speeches, differentiating himself from traditional petismo.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que Flávio participará de seu programa eleitoral
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) announced that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will participate in his election campaign TV programs, including future recordings and mutual appearances. Tarcísio also commented on the 'Dark Horse' case, stating that Flávio has already clarified the funding he received from Daniel Vorcaro for the film about former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende destravar licenças ambientais para liberar obras de resorts em Angra
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used Angra dos Reis as a stage to criticize the Angra 3 nuclear plant and advocate for unblocking environmental licenses to speed up resort construction, reinforcing an infrastructure agenda with private initiative. During a parade, he emphasized reviewing municipal master plans to enable large developments in the region. The agenda reinforces his more moderated approach, focusing on economic development proposals.

item.title: Lula mira mulheres, já celebra fim da 6 X 1 e chama Marisa de Janja
item.description: Lula attended the 'Women with Lula' event in Belo Horizonte, emphasizing the importance of female voters and celebrating the approval of the 6x1 workday reduction. During his speech, he mistakenly confused the names of Duque Lula and Janja.

item.title: Em Minas, Lula defende igualdade de gênero em cargos de gestão no governo
item.description: At an event in Belo Horizonte, Lula advocated for gender equality in management positions, noting that women hold only 38% of these roles and urging votes for female candidates. He also announced that Congress will approve the end of the 6x1 shift schedule this week, a policy aimed at improving work-life balance.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que estará no programa de Flávio e minimiza Dark Horse
item.description: Tarcísio announced a partnership with Flávio Bolsonaro for TV programs and downplayed the 'Dark House' film controversy, while reinforcing alliances with senators Derrite and André do Prado. At the Igreja Videira during the Elas 2026 conference, he advocated for policies supporting female entrepreneurship, with investments of R$ 800 million in his first term and a new program for entrepreneurial mothers.

item.title: Previsíveis, Lula e Flávio correm atrás do eleitor-pêndulo
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro launched their campaigns during the free electoral time slot with cautious messages, avoiding controversial statements. Both candidates aim to win over the swing voter who will decide the next presidency. The strategy suggests a balanced race with no early front-runners.

item.title: Lula exalta Janja e fim da 6x1 em ato de mulheres em MG com protesto de petistas
item.description: Lula attended a meeting with the female electorate in Belo Horizonte and highlighted the importance of women in politics, announcing plans to approve the end of the 6x1 work schedule next week.

item.title: Mulher de Flávio diz que reeducou o marido para ele ser “moderado”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro released an electoral advertisement in which his wife, Fernanda, claims she 'reeducated' him, presenting him as the 'moderate Bolsonaro'. The campaign emphasizes traditional family values and criticizes Lula's government, highlighting insecurity and economic hardship.

item.title: Lula diz que enfrenta poderosos, e Flávio Bolsonaro busca voto feminino em primeiro programa na TV
item.description: Lula (PT) emphasized confronting powerful interests in his first TV campaign program, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) focused on winning female voters. Both use distinct strategies to attract voters.

item.title: Com troca de farpas, presidenciáveis estreiam propaganda eleitoral na TV
item.description: Brazilian presidential candidates debuted on TV this Saturday (Aug 29) with exchanges of criticism and policy proposals. Flávio Bolsonaro highlighted women's issues and the economy, while Lula opened his program attacking his rival, mentioning cases like 'rachadinhas' and Banco Master. Caiado and Cury kept the tone from radio, focusing on criticism of the PT and personal trajectories.

item.title: Marina rebate Flávio Bolsonaro sobre clima: ‘Saneamento é importante, mas não resolve mudança do clima’
item.description: Marina Silva countered Flávio Bolsonaro's climate change criticisms, labeling them as denialist. At a Haddad event in Osasco, she emphasized that sanitation is important but does not solve climate issues, highlighting Lula's reduction of deforestation rates.

item.title: Janja faz comigo quase o que minha mãe fazia, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula said, during the 'Women with Lula' event, that First Lady Janja does to him almost what his mother used to do, highlighting women's importance in the campaign and reaffirming his family ties. He emphasized that women must be treated as first-class citizens and not continue as second-class.

item.title: Lula diz que 6 X 1 será aprovada nesta semana
item.description: President Lula stated that the approval of the 6 X 1 work schedule should occur next week, emphasizing that the reduction of the workday is 'a sacred thing'. The bill was stalled in the Senate but advanced after a meeting between Lula and Alcolumbre. The rapporteur, Omar Aziz, presented a favorable opinion, keeping the text from the Chamber.

item.title: Lula diz que Congresso aprovará fim da escala 6x1 e que nenhum país vai ‘meter o bedelho’ no Brasil
item.description: President Lula stated that Congress will approve the end of the 6x1 work schedule and reiterated his commitment to national sovereignty, saying no foreign government will interfere in Brazil while he is in office. He attended an event in Belo Horizonte on women's participation in politics and urged votes for female candidates. Both issues remain central to his campaign agenda.

item.title: A eleição que resiste a mudar; leia análise de Felipe Nunes
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian presidential election remains stable and polarized between Lula and the Bolsonaro camp, now led by Flávio Bolsonaro, according to Felipe Nunes of Quaest. State polls show regional fluctuations but no national wave, with Lula strong in the Northeast and Flávio inheriting conservative support in the South and Midwest.

item.title: Em meio à tensão com EUA, Lula diz que ninguém "meterá o bedelho no Brasil"
item.description: At a rally in Belo Horizonte, Lula declared that no foreign government will interfere in Brazil during his term, amid tensions with the US. He also forecast approval of the end to the 6×1 work schedule this week and emphasized actions in education and combatting feminicide.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que brasileiro consome menos porque dinheiro 'está indo para bet'
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas criticized the federal government at a São Paulo campaign event, claiming Brazilian money is going to sports betting instead of stimulating consumption. He emphasized his re-election campaign focused on public security and distinguished his ballot number from other candidates, urging voters to choose him for governor. He also attended a religious gathering with local leaders to strengthen regional alliances.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro presta solidariedade a Renata Vasconcellos após embate com Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro expressed solidarity with journalist Renata Vasconcellos after she had a tense exchange with President Lula during a TV Globo interview. During his own interview, Flávio criticized Lula's behavior, calling it 'disrespectful', and stated that presenters would be free to ask him any questions. The incident occurred amid the broadcaster's series of interviews with presidential candidates.

item.title: A noite de comemoração da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro após sabatina na TV Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign team celebrated his performance during a TV Globo interview, partying until dawn at a pizzeria near former president Bolsonaro's residence. Allies believe he skillfully avoided sensitive questions, such as his ties to former banker Daniel Vorcaro, accused of massive financial fraud.

item.title: TSE inicia julgamento de registros de Lula, Flávio, Zema e Renan na segunda-feira
item.description: The TSE begins judging the candidacy registration of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Romeu Zema and Renan Santos. The Public Ministry indicated no legal impediments for them to run for President.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que trará Flávio para sua propaganda eleitoral e compara situação do país à 'opressão' vivida por Israel na Bíblia
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas announced he will bring Flávio Bolsonaro to his TV show and compared Brazil's situation to the 'oppression' suffered by Israel in the Bible during a religious event. Both candidates avoided detailed comments on the 'Dark horse' case.

item.title: Que horas começa a sabatina de Augusto Cury no 'Jornal Nacional'?
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) is the interviewee this Saturday (29) on TV Globo's candidate roundtable, airing at 9:20 PM after 'Jornal Nacional'. The interview will be conducted by journalists César Tralli and Renata Vasconcellos, broadcast on TV Globo, GloboNews, and g1.

item.title: Sabatina de Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo foi 100% feita de cinismo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro showed inconsistent behavior during interviews, being rude to a Folha journalist about accountability for R$61 million and, days later, responding respectfully on the same topic. The conduct suggests a disconnect between discourse and action, sparking criticism over cynical interview styles.

item.title: TSE concede liminar e suspende restrições à campanha de Anthony Garotinho
item.description: The TSE granted an injunction to former governor Anthony Garotinho, suspending restrictions imposed by the Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court on access to campaign funds and electoral airtime. The ruling allows the Republican candidate for governor to resume his campaign with all legally guaranteed rights.

item.title: Lula pode perder 1 aliado no Senado em 2027
item.description: The federal government is projected to lose one ally in the Senate in 2027, dropping from 30 to 29 seats. The opposition leads the polls with 27 competitive candidates, while the government has 21, suggesting a more opposition-led Senate in the upcoming legislative term.

item.title: Oposição não deve ter votos para afastar ministros do STF em 2027
item.description: The opposition bench in the 2027 Senate is projected to grow to 43 senators, securing an absolute majority, but falling short of the 54 votes required to remove Supreme Court justices via impeachment. The current electoral landscape indicates 29 pro-government, 43 opposition, and 17 swing senators among the 81 seats.

item.title: Três Poderes: Renan Santos é o vencedor da semana; lobista, a perdedora
item.description: Renan Santos (Mission) was named the winner of the week after standing out in debates on Band and JN with bold proposals and strong oratory. The week also highlighted the negative influence of lobbyists in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Liminar do TSE garante retorno de Garotinho à campanha ao governo do RJ
item.description: The TSE granted an injunction to former governor Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos), allowing him to resume his campaign for the Rio de Janeiro governorship. The decision by Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques lifted restrictions that had prevented the candidate from receiving funding and airing content during electoral hours. Regional justice had questioned the validity of his clean record, but the TSE deemed the legal controversy sufficient to maintain his political activities pending final analysis.

item.title: Ancelotti revela que foi à França observar Marquinhos, Beraldo e Alexsandro
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti traveled to France to watch the Lille vs PSG match, where he and assistant Paul Clement observed players such as Alexsandro, Marquinhos, and Beraldo. The Brazilian national team coach shared his presence at the game on social media, highlighting close monitoring of the athletes. Marquinhos, playing for PSG, scored a last-minute header to secure the draw.

item.title: Eventos esportivos e culturais alteram o trânsito neste fim de semana no DF
item.description: Traffic in Brasília will be affected this weekend due to sports and cultural events. Road closures and interventions are scheduled on the Monumental Axis and neighborhoods such as Cruzeiro, Lago Sul, Guará, Ceilândia, Gama and Brazlândia, with traffic agents guiding drivers and ensuring safety.

item.title: Governo prevê empréstimo de R$ 6 bilhões aos Correios no Orçamento de 2027
item.description: The federal government proposes a R$ 6 billion loan to the Post Office in the 2027 Annual Budget Law to strengthen the cash flow of the company, which faces financial difficulties and need for restructuring. The funding will be made through a credit operation, with impact on the nominal result, but no direct effect on the primary result, to be used for the maintenance of activities and coverage of current expenses. In 2025, the Post Office already received an injection of R$ 12 billion.

item.title: Justiça marca audiência entre governo Lula e Discord
item.description: The Federal Court of the Federal District scheduled a conciliation hearing between the federal government and Discord, after the Union sued the platform for alleged failures in protecting users, especially children and adolescents. The action follows the breakdown of negotiations for a Behavioral Adjustment Agreement.

item.title: Os desafios das comissões de heteroidentificação
item.description: The text examines racial self-declaration review committees in Brazilian universities, highlighting their origins in affirmative action quotas and implementation challenges. Through studies from USP and UFABC, it reveals legal and institutional dilemmas in phenotypic classification, excluding ancestry criteria to combat fraud in racial self-declaration.

item.title: Em carreata, Celina pede voto em “chapa fechada” com Flávio, Michelle e Bia
item.description: During a rally in Samambaia, Federal District Governor Celina Leão (PP) called for a unified vote for PL candidates including Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro, Bia Kicis, and Zé Humberto (MDB). She emphasized the importance of voting as a bloc on the right and criticized past left-wing administrations for delayed salaries while highlighting her government's initiatives such as the GDF na Sua Porta program.

item.title: Evento com Lula em BH tem protesto de petistas por recursos de campanha
item.description: At an event with Lula in Belo Horizonte, PT supporters protested against the party's electoral resource distribution, claiming candidates were left without campaign funding. The group, including 25 candidates for Congress from Minas Gerais, demands a minimum of BRL 80,000 per candidacy and threatens legal action if no internal resolution is reached. Protesters highlighted disparities in fund allocation, with some receiving up to BRL 2.4 million while others received nothing.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro ignora detalhes importantes ao cantar vitória
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro prematurely celebrates victory by comparing 2022 and 2026 polls, overlooking that Flávio Bolsonaro lacks the institutional power that Jair Bolsonaro had as president. Despite the technical tie in voting intentions, Flávio's campaign is weaker, without Centrão support or public machinery. The 2026 electoral scenario shows greater competitiveness, but structural conditions differ significantly from previous elections.

item.title: Como a reforma eleitoral beneficiou sigla ligada à Universal
item.description: Brazil's electoral reform, which restricted campaign spending and banned corporate donations, benefited the Republicanos party due to its strong ties to the Universal Truth Church, which has organizational structure and mobilization capacity without relying on financial resources. A study by researchers from Insper, Harvard, and Princeton found that the church's centralization and influence offset the reduced funding available for campaigns.

item.title: Lula e Flávio trocam ataques na estreia da propaganda no rádio
item.description: The first radio campaign ads of the 2026 election featured mutual attacks between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), each using their airtime to criticize the opponent while reinforcing their own public image. The radio broadcast marked the beginning of the electoral war of narratives.

item.title: Negar o aquecimento global é “amadorismo irresponsável”, diz Lula
item.description: Lula criticized climate change deniers, calling it 'irresponsible amateurism'. He highlighted investments in basic sanitation, reduced deforestation, and integrated firefighting actions. The president responded to Flávio Bolsonaro's statements that extreme weather events are cyclical phenomena.

item.title: Como lobista paga o aluguel da mansão onde Lulinha fazia negócios
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger pays the rent for a mansion in Brasília used by Lulinha and his son for meetings with ministers and businessmen, under investigation for suspected influence peddling. The property, located 8 km from the Planalto Palace, has monthly expenses of around R$ 100,000, according to documents attached to the Federal Police investigation. The lease was signed by Rafael Nicolau Arbex, a friend of Fernando Bittar, Lulinha's partner.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis neste fim de semana (29 e 30)
item.description: Presidential candidates maintain an intense schedule this weekend with debates, rallies, infrastructure events, and minority-focused activities. Figures like Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Caiado stand out in regional events. The TSE is also preparing to judge candidate registration records.

item.title: “Candidatos à Presidência definem agenda de fim de semana”
item.description: Presidential candidates have a busy weekend agenda with debates, political events, and visits to affected areas. Themes like infrastructure, women, culture, and art stand out. Not all candidates publish their public schedules.

item.title: Lula chama Flávio de ‘pior dos Bolsonaros’ na estreia no rádio; senador aposta em economia e família
item.description: In his debut on radio campaign ads, Lula emphasized his legacy, including the creation of 'Pé-de-Meia' and taking Brazil off the Hunger Map, while attacking Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him 'the worst of the Bolsonaros' over corruption allegations and kickbacks. Flávio, in turn, criticized the country's economy, highlighted his track record in public security, and touched on family matters, noting his daughters' influence on his life. Both used the platform to present their proposals and reinforce their voter bases.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos à Presidência da República do Brasil nas eleições 2026
item.description: Thirteen candidates officially launched their campaigns for the 2026 Brazilian presidency following the closure of party conventions. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva seeks re-election under the PT, while Flávio Bolsonaro represents Jair Bolsonaro's legacy for the PL. The race includes figures from various parties such as Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Augusto Cury (Avante), and Zema (Novo), with the first round scheduled for October 4th.

item.title: Planalto orienta ministros a viajarem para promover o governo petista durante a campanha
item.description: The federal government instructs ministers to travel in order to politically promote the petista government during the campaign, under the pretext of completing deliveries. Aides were summoned to the Planalto to be held accountable for campaign commitment, causing discomfort due to electoral bias.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sobrevive a teste no JN, mas não explica filme nem detalha propostas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) passed his first major interview on Jornal Nacional without major controversies, but avoided explaining the 'Dark Horse' film and did not detail economic proposals. Regarding the scandal involving Daniel Vorcaro, he claimed the relationship was purely professional and shifted blame to Lula. He dodged questions on fiscal adjustments and repeated old Bolsonaro administration formulas, without announcing ministers or concrete proposals.

item.title: Horário eleitoral no rádio e na TV: veja horários, onde assistir e tempo dos candidatos
item.description: Free electoral advertising on radio and TV for presidential and federal deputy candidates begins this Saturday, with fixed time slots such as 1 p.m. and 8:30 p.m. on TV and 7 a.m. and 12 p.m. on radio. President Lula (PT) leads with 5 minutes and 31 seconds, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 4 minutes and 20 seconds, based on parliamentary representation rules.

item.title: 'Dark Horse': investigadores rechaçam 'patrocínio' e apuram suspeitas de corrupção e lavagem nos negócios de Flávio Bolsonaro com o filme
item.description: Federal police are investigating suspected passive corruption and money laundering involving Flávio Bolsonaro and the film 'Dark Horse', reportedly funded by Daniel Vorcaro. While the PL presidential candidate claims it was a private sponsorship, investigators are scrutinizing the origin, transfer, and use of the funds, as well as pressure on Vorcaro not to be listed as sponsor. The PF is also reviewing statements by Valdemar Costa Neto about seeking money at Vorcaro's residence.

item.title: A ideia é boa, Dr. Cury, mas não vai rolar
item.description: The article laments the spectacle-driven turn of politics and the decline of debates, echoing Augusto Cury's criticism of digital aggression, but concludes that the electoral market rewards emotion and profanity over technical proposals.
